answer_2.quote: Following prior work, we use several methods to measure the diversity of the generated outputs... D-1 and D-2... ENTR... BLEU, ROUGE-L, and METEOR, as well as the cosine similarity...

answer_4.quote: To assess desideratum (2), we conduct a human evaluation of 100 randomly sampled examples on two metrics associated with response quality, namely, whether the generated responses are engaging and relevant given the dialogue context.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are tasked to make a pairwise comparison between responses from a pair of generation methods on whether they are engaging and relevant.
